name: Pistachio White Hot Chocolate

instructions.primary_message: For the Hot Chocolate: In a small saucepan, bring pistachio milk to a simmer over medium heat. Add white chocolate and whisk constantly until chocolate is melted, about 1 minute. Turn off heat.
Off heat, whisk in pistachio cream until well combined. Taste and season with salt if desired. Set aside while preparing cold foam.

For the Cold Foam: In a small jar or measuring cup, use a hand-held milk frother or immersion blender to whisk half-and-half until light and airy like sea foam and just barely flowing, 30 to 60 seconds. Alternatively, use a personal blender and pulse for a few seconds until light and airy.
Pour pistachio hot chocolate into 2 mugs and top with cold foam. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: pistachio cream, white chocolate, hot chocolate

description: Pistachio milk warmed with white chocolate, blended with pistachio cream, and topped with a foamy dollop of cold cream creates an unforgettable twist on hot chocolate.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Pinch kosher salt (optional)

Notes: Pistachio cream is available at most major retailers and Italian specialty stores, usually located near the other nut butters and spreads. I recommend looking for a spread that uses pistachios from Sicily, such as Pisti or Pistacchiosa.

Make-ahead and storage: This pistachio white hot chocolate is best enjoyed immediately.
author: Kelli Solomon
